sources.title: Liquid AI ships LFM2.5-2.6B agent model that runs on-device
sources.snippet: TL;DR Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B on August 4, 2026, a 2.6 billion parameter model pre-trained on roughly 34 trillion tokens for agent workloads. The company reports 220 tokens per second on an Apple M5 Max, 30 tokens per second on a smartphone, and under 2.5 GB of memory to run. sources.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-2.6B, an On-Device Agentic Model
sources.snippet: PVP portfolio company Liquid AI has released LFM2.5-2.6B, an agentic foundation model that runs entirely on-device. Small enough to run on a phone and responsive on a CPU, the 2.6-billion-parameter model is built to plan, call tools, and complete multi-step tasks without depending on cloud APIs.
